title: Every step of the build process is held by a mechanism, end to end
why: Owner ask ask-mw74ru2o9t, 19:05 CST Nov 7: "well i meant more outcomes wise this whole process sshd have bene mechanicslly held end to end". At 13:25 CST, 14 now-steps had no lane and nothing started them; they started only because the owner asked.
note: Scope: walk the process from a found gap to a merged fix (finding, step, lane start, review, hand-off, batch, merge, close) and name the mechanism that holds each hand-over, or file the missing one. Step pr-state-is-on-the-pr (the PR ledger, which also covers ready steps) is one part. Rule outcomes-mechanize-rules is the standing ruling. Lane plan (coordinator 19:07 CST): an audit, then a decision record, then step slugs to triage.
